news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
news.summary: Luxor raised $16 million to expand into AI hardware and trading, betting that computing power will become a market where companies can hedge costs and prices.

news.title: Hayes details FLOP’s AI compute derivatives vision after selling his altcoins
news.summary: Arthur Hayes revealed the derivatives market design for Flop Network and how he expects its native token could transform AI compute into a tradable commodity.

news.title: Luxor raises $16M from CMT Digital amid AI-Bitcoin miner convergence
news.summary: Luxor aims to use the proceeds to scale its existing AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU sourcing services as global chip supply chains become constrained.

news.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
news.summary: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.

news.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants subsidy, citing $125 million treasury
news.summary: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending automatic grants funding, citing a treasury valuation of more than $125 million.

news.title: Bitcoin shows signs of weakness while Ripple's bank win fails to bolster XRP
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 27, 2026

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds below $80,000 as AI buildout draws investor attention and capital
news.summary: Interest rates and oil are slipping and equities are rising, but crypto remains under pressure.

news.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
news.summary: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

news.title: Bitcoin drops below $80,000 as crypto ignores Asian tech rally, Fed meeting begins
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $79,700 since midnight UTC while Asian tech stocks rallied. The DeFi index dropped 1.8%, and the Fed is set to begin a two-day meeting.

news.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
news.summary: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

news.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
news.summary: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

news.title: Ark Invest buys $5.2 million of Circle shares, sells $15.9 million of its own Bitcoin ETF as BTC grinds lower
news.summary: Ark Invest rebalanced its fund weightings, adding Circle shares and trimming its Bitcoin ETF holdings as BTC fell below $80,000.

news.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
news.summary: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

news.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
news.summary: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

news.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
news.summary: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.

news.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
news.summary: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

news.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
news.summary: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

news.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
news.summary: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.

news.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
news.summary: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

news.title: Circle faces up to 20% revenue risk from AI agents, Mizuho says
news.summary: Mizuho cited 10-20% medium-term reserve revenue downside risk as AI agents steer USDC holders toward higher-yielding fiat alternatives.

news.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
news.summary: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.

news.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
news.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

news.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
news.summary: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

news.title: StoneX lifts Strive price target 34% as new stock offering bolsters bitcoin strategy
news.summary: StoneX has raised its price target for bitcoin treasury company Strive to $43 from $32 and reiterated its Buy rating on the stock.

news.title: Ripple gains final OCC approval to launch national trust bank and bring RLUSD under federal oversight
news.summary: Ripple's structure places reserve management and custody under federal supervision while leaving issuance with the New York-regulated entity.

news.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
news.summary: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.

news.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
news.summary: BlackRock, SBI Holdings, and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

news.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
news.summary: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

news.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
news.summary: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

news.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
news.summary: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

news.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
news.summary: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

news.title: CZ pitches BNB Chain’s role in AI as BNB Standard rings Nasdaq bell
news.summary: CZ sees AI driving crypto use, while BNB Standard plans to expand beyond holding tokens in its treasury.

news.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
news.summary: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

news.title: Hyperliquid says Kraken parent Payward to be first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer
news.summary: Hyperliquid plans to make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, a step toward regulated U.S. perpetual futures.

news.title: Y Combinator-backed Mochatrade raises $5.5 million to offer US stock perpetuals to Indian traders
news.summary: The platform is in beta and plans to open to the public in the coming weeks, co-founder Chetan Manda told The Block.

news.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
news.summary: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

news.title: Prediction markets and derivatives drive Bernstein’s crypto stock outlook for Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle
news.summary: Bernstein cuts Coinbase’s target while raising Circle’s as new products shift their earnings outlook.

news.title: NBA becomes third league to sign CFTC prediction market pact, taps Kalshi and Polymarket
news.summary: The CFTC and NBA have agreed to put in place standards to protect the integrity of the game when it comes to prediction markets.

news.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
news.summary: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

news.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
news.summary: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

news.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
news.summary: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

news.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
news.summary: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

news.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
news.summary: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

news.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
news.summary: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

news.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
news.summary: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

news.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
news.summary: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

news.title: Tom Lee insists ‘crypto bull market is underway’ as Bitmine adds 10,452 ETH
news.summary: The company's combined crypto, cash, marketable securities, and other investments totaled $15 billion as of Oct. 25.

news.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
news.summary: Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.

news.title: Strategy pauses bitcoin buys, repurchases $205 million of STRC preferred shares
news.summary: Strategy's bitcoin holdings account for roughly 4% of the total supply cap, with $3.9 billion in paper gains.

news.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
news.summary: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

news.title: Strive closes in on second-largest corporate bitcoin treasury with $511 million purchase
news.summary: Strive's latest bitcoin purchase puts it within 1,000 BTC of second-place Metaplanet as it unveils a new $1 billion preferred stock offering program.

news.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
news.summary: Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.

news.title: Galaxy says bitcoin bear market is over; now is the time to buy and hold
news.summary: Galaxy said bitcoin’s bear market ended in June as fading long-term holder selling signals an attractive buying opportunity.

news.title: A $68 million bitcoin bet is targeting a post-midterm election breakout to $90,000
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 26, 2026

news.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
news.summary: The move marks Aviva’s second fund to list tokenized shares, part of a broader collaboration to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.

news.title: Aviva Investors, Ripple launch tokenized share class of $29 billion sterling fund on XRP Ledger
news.summary: Aviva Investors has launched a tokenized share class of its Sterling Liquidity Fund on the Ripple-backed XRP Ledger.

news.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as oil retreats and the Fed decision looms
news.summary: Bitcoin was little changed near $80,400 since midnight UTC while the DeFi index was the only CoinDesk index to gain, with the Fed due to decide on Wednesday.

news.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
news.summary: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

news.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
news.summary: Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.

news.title: Calpers pulls back from big tech as AI jitters deepen neocloud sell-off
news.summary: California’s pension fund shifts toward private equity as investors question tech valuations and the payoff from soaring AI spending.

news.title: Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
news.summary: SECZ’s onchain market cap fell to $208.6 million as Circle-linked tokens reached a combined $383.6 million across several issuers in the $3.3 billion tokenized equities market.

news.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay of crypto gains tax, eyes 2029 start: report
news.summary: The delay reportedly aims to align with the U.S. schedule of integrating CARF, the OECD's international tax framework for digital assets.

news.title: Fed, ECB and BOJ interest-rate decisions, Coinbase earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 26.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with $301 million in net inflows after a strong three-day start gave way to heavy withdrawals.

news.title: Over 11 million bitcoin has no known owner. Here's what it means
news.summary: The large number of coins held in unidentified wallets shows that retail investors have been in this market for years, observers said. But this interpretation comes with a caveat.

news.title: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
news.summary: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like "a false alarm."

news.title: Keystone customers say breach exposed data the hardware wallet maker promised to delete
news.summary: Keystone has said it deletes customer information 180 days after their orders in most cases, though X users have cast doubt on that claim.

news.title: Crypto longs lose $404 million in four hours as bitcoin briefly slips below $80,000
news.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $773 million on Thursday and Friday after three days of net inflows, per SoSoValue data.
